The crisp, aromatic skin is particularly delicious.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Porgies are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are made when [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]] and [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]] are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They also have a chance of being dropped by [[Blue Hinox]]es when felled by [[Link]]. They have a delicious, crisp skin and a soft and fluffy texture. Eating one restores one and a half of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Porgies reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]] and [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]] to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They have a delicious, crisp skin and a soft and fluffy texture. Eating one restores one and a half of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Porgy * Porgy * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
